headline: Collective declines on Gulf stock exchanges amid rising geopolitical tensions
summary: Most Gulf bourses closed lower as traders assessed fallout from disturbances in the Strait of Hormuz. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index fell 0.7%, Qatar's dropped 1.8% and Bahrain's fell 0.4%.
why: Saudi Arabia's Tadawul is the largest stock exchange in the Gulf region, and regional equity moves reflect investor sentiment toward Gulf oil exporters and geopolitical risk.
why_moved: Traders assessed the fallout from disturbances in the Strait of Hormuz amid rising regional geopolitical tensions, pushing most Gulf indices lower.
